_: The geography of the galaxy: the six laws that vary from place to place, the zones, the spiral arms, and the named places a run can be set in. The laws are formulas in the galaxy package; this file says what each is. Every value but metals is relative to the Sun's neighbourhood, which is 1.
laws: key and what it does. zones: the named regions the galaxy is divided into, from the centre out, with the rule that puts a place in each.

arms: the spiral arms, inner to outer as they cross the Sun's azimuth: key, name, short name, r_sun (kpc at the Sun's azimuth), pitch (degrees), width (kpc, roughly the half-width), from and to (the unwrapped azimuth range in degrees), major, desc.

presets: the named places a run can be set in: key, name, the code the star designations carry, the position in galactocentric kpc (x toward the centre from the Sun, y along the rotation, z toward the north pole), desc.
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.

laws.name: stellar density
laws.desc: the number of stars in a volume, relative to the Sun's neighbourhood: thin disc, thick disc, boxy bulge, bar, nuclear cluster, halo, and a modest enhancement in the arms; it sets how close the stars are

laws.name: star formation
laws.desc: the rate of star formation: where the massive stars are, and so the supernovae, the nebulae and the hard sky; it follows the gas, the arms, the molecular ring at the bar's end and the central molecular zone, and the bar's interior and the halo are barren

laws.name: metallicity
laws.desc: the metallicity in dex, 0 at the Sun, richer inward and in the bar, poorer outward, in the thick disc and in the halo; it takes metals to make rocky worlds

laws.name: hard sky
laws.desc: cosmic rays from young stars, the X-ray glow of the centre, the echoes of its outbursts; what makes the surface of a world a bad place to keep a biosphere, and the baseline hazard of the history

laws.name: stellar encounters
laws.desc: the rate at which other stars pass close: density times the velocity spread, high in the bulge and the halo, enormous inside a globular cluster

laws.name: deep physics
laws.desc: how much the neighbourhood teaches about the deep physics: dead stars, collapsed stars, the great hole at the centre; a multiplier on research in the exotic domain

zones.name: the Halo
zones.rule: more than 1.5 kpc above the plane, or more than 22 kpc out

arms.name: the Scutum-Centaurus Arm
arms.desc: one of the two great arms, rooted at the near end of the bar; heavy with gas, stars and the clusters of red supergiants where it meets the bar

arms.name: the Sagittarius-Carina Arm
arms.desc: a minor arm bright with nebulae: the Lagoon, the Eagle, the Omega, and Carina with its doomed giant

arms.name: the Local Arm
arms.desc: a short spur between the two great arms; the Sun rides its inner edge, with Orion and Cygnus for neighbours

arms.name: the Perseus Arm
arms.desc: the other great arm, rooted at the far end of the bar; the outer sky of the Sun's neighbourhood, with the Double Cluster and Cassiopeia A

arms.name: the Norma-Outer Arm
arms.desc: the last arm before the rim, thin and cold; its inner end is the Norma arm on the far side of the centre

presets.name: the Sun's neighbourhood
presets.desc: where the story begins: the real stars within 150 light years of Earth

presets.name: the Heart
presets.desc: a hundred light years from Sagittarius A*, inside the nuclear cluster

presets.name: the Core
presets.desc: the central molecular zone, six hundred light years from the hole

presets.name: the Bulge
presets.desc: the old red stars of the bulge, a kiloparsec above the centre's fire

presets.name: the Bar
presets.desc: halfway along the bar, among ancient metal-rich stars

presets.name: the Molecular Ring
presets.desc: the ring at the bar's end where the great arms are born

presets.name: the Scutum-Centaurus Arm
presets.desc: the near great arm, inward of the Sun

presets.name: the Sagittarius Arm
presets.desc: the bright minor arm inward of the Sun

presets.name: the gap inside the Local Arm
presets.desc: the quiet space between the Sagittarius and Local arms

presets.name: the Outer Disc
presets.desc: between the Perseus and Outer arms, thin and cold

presets.name: the Rim
presets.desc: beyond the last arm, where the disc gives out

presets.name: the Halo
presets.desc: three kiloparsecs above the Sun, among the old stars of the halo

presets.name: the Far Side
presets.desc: the Sun's mirror across the centre
